map.kristalltal.name: Crystal Valley
cmd.group: Group {n}: tap = select, long press = save
ui.rotate: Please rotate your device to landscape
help.title: Controls
help.mouse.1: Left click: select unit · Drag a box: select several
help.mouse.2: Double click: all units of that type on screen
help.mouse.3: Right click: move here · Right drag: pan the map
help.mouse.4: Screen edge, arrow keys (WASD without selection): camera · Wheel: zoom
help.mouse.5: Ctrl+number: save group · Number: select group (twice = jump to it)
help.mouse.6: S: stop · Space: jump to selection · Esc: clear selection
help.touch.1: Tap: select unit · Double tap: all of that type on screen
help.touch.2: With a selection, tap the ground: move here
help.touch.3: Long press and drag: selection box
help.touch.4: Drag (1 or 2 fingers): pan the map · Two fingers: zoom
help.touch.5: Group buttons: tap = select, long press = save
